home.heading: What tale shall we tell?
home.tagline: One sentence is enough. You bring the idea; the craft is my part.
home.premiseLabel: In a sentence, what is it about?
home.premisePlaceholder: A mapmaker receives an unsigned map drawn in her lost sister's hand.
home.beginHeading: How would you like to begin?

shape.label: Shape
shape.title: I have an idea
shape.body: We talk it through. I ask plain questions, then sketch your cast, your world and the main events for you to approve.

write.label: Write
write.title: I'm already writing
write.body: Bring your manuscript. I read it, note who is who and what has happened, and help you carry on from where you stopped.

home.changeLater: You can change this for any story, at any time.
home.emptyLibrary: No stories yet. Yours will appear here.

section.comingBody: This page arrives in a later step of the redesign. Until then, everything still works in the current workspace.

ideate.subtitle: Talk it through. I ask; you answer in your own words.
ideate.empty: Tell me about your story in your own words. Or choose something on the right and I will draft it for you to approve.
ideate.composerPlaceholder: It does not need to be well written. Just tell me.
ideate.deleteConfirm: Delete this conversation? This cannot be undone.

draft.heading: A draft: {{type}}
draft.note: A draft. Nothing is kept until you say so.
draft.undone: Taken back out. You can still keep it.

write.deleteConfirm: Move “{{title}}” to the trash? You can restore it from there.
write.conflict: This chapter was changed in another window. Your text here is kept. Keep this version (the other one stays in the chapter's history), or load the saved one.

hints.continue: Adds new text at the end of this chapter.
hints.expand: Select a passage first. I add detail without changing what happens.
hints.shorten: Select a passage first. I keep what matters and cut the rest.
hints.polish: Select a passage first. Same events, better telling.
hints.custom: Works on the selection if there is one, otherwise adds at the end.

assist.instructionPlaceholder: What should happen, in your own words. It does not need to be well written.
assist.selectFirst: Select some text in the chapter first.
assist.checksPassed: Nothing here disagrees with what the story has established.
assist.falseAlarmReason: Why is this fine? (Saved with the check.)
assist.accepted: Added to the chapter. The earlier text is kept in the chapter's history.
assist.unchanged: Your text changes only when you add this.
assist.noChange: The suggestion is the same as your text, so there is nothing to change.

checks.intro: I read the chapter, compare it with what the story has established, and list new facts for you to confirm.
checks.nothingPending: No new facts waiting for you.

history.intro: Every save keeps the text it replaced. Name a version to find it easily.
history.restoreNote: The text you have now is kept in the history too.
history.restored: Restored. The text from before is kept in the history.

scenes.intro: Plan the scenes of this chapter. The order is the plan; it does not move written text.
scenes.deleteConfirm: Delete this scene from the plan? The chapter text stays.
scenes.place: Where in the chapter: select the passage, then use the button.
scenes.needsPlace: The text around this scene changed. Select its passage again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.general: Language and theme are at the top of every page.

ai.heading: AI
ai.intro: Choose the model that writes with you. Connection details are set where the server runs; nothing secret is entered here.
ai.testMode: This server runs with the built-in test AI. Its answers are fixed samples.
ai.noModels: No models are available. Check the AI configuration on the server.
ai.keysNote: API keys stay in the server's environment and are never shown or sent from this page.

usage.heading: Usage
usage.total: {{used}} tokens used today, of a daily limit of {{limit}}.
usage.unknown_one: {{count}} call did not report its usage.
usage.unknown_other: {{count}} calls did not report their usage.
usage.noPrices: No prices are configured, so no costs are estimated.

backup.heading: Backup
backup.intro: A backup holds every story, its history and its covers in one file.
backup.last_one: Last automatic backup {{when}}. One is made every {{hours}} hours; the last {{count}} is kept.
backup.last_other: Last automatic backup {{when}}. One is made every {{hours}} hours; the last {{count}} are kept.
backup.none: No automatic backup yet. One is made every {{hours}} hours.
backup.replaceNote: Restoring replaces the whole library with the backup's contents.
backup.confirm_one: This backup holds {{count}} story. It will replace your whole library. Continue?
backup.confirm_other: This backup holds {{count}} stories. It will replace your whole library. Continue?

import.title: Import a manuscript
import.intro: Chapters are found from headings such as “Chapter 1” or “第一章”. Check them before importing.

warnings.DOCX_TEXT_ONLY: From Word files only the text and bold, italic and underline are imported; images, headers, comments and complex styles are not.
warnings.DECODED_GB18030: Read as GB18030. Check that the text looks right.

story.title: Story settings
story.name: Title
story.languageNote: The language the story is written in. The assistant writes in this language.
story.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{title}}” and all of its chapters? This cannot be undone.

language.label: Interface language
language.storyLanguageNote: The interface language does not change the language of your stories.
